policy.singleton_policy: retain only at-or-above median quality when nonredundant
policy.action_policy: successful source commands only; remove duplicate, housekeeping, low-value, and causally weak actions
policy.supervised_command_normalization: strictly translate admitted read-only PowerShell to Codex CLI exec_command Linux commands with repository-relative saved_configs paths; retain exact archived source and inner PowerShell for audit
policy.hypothesis_elimination_policy: mine at most one exact visible-source elimination statement per retained path when already-returned successful tool evidence can be attached; never synthesize a missing rejection
policy.path_endpoint_policy: one grounded evidence_summary, one explicit decision_ready, and one verified decision per retained path; sample the three nodes as an indivisible endpoint group
policy.final_decision_policy: retain every verified path decision in the semantic pool; equal query/path-group exposure is enforced by epoch schedules
policy.infrastructure_failures_and_interruption: not archived, clustered, counted, or trained
